summary: The NFL wanted both the Bucs and Seahawks to play every team in the NFL during their first two years which is why they started out in the "wrong" conferences. The NFL knew the Bucs and Seahawks would end up in the western divisions when they moved to their permanent conferences and so they just had them play in the West divisions the first year.
